description: Enforced per-tool output budget. `server/compose-mcp.js:19` declares a 2,000-token soft cap (mcp-connector design Decision 6) as a COMMENT, and per-tool `limit` params implement it ad hoc and inconsistently; nothing fails when a tool blows it. COMP-AUDIT-19 fixed exactly one offender (add_roadmap_entry, 193,821 chars) by hand, which is a treadmill: the next writer that injects a rendered document into its result is undetectable until an agent hits the MCP token cap mid-task. Slice: declare a cap per tool, render every tool's result against a realistic large fixture (compose's own ~190KB roadmap, 350 features) in a test, and FAIL the suite when a result exceeds its declared cap or when a tool has no declared cap at all (an undeclared tool is a failure, not a skip). Prior art: Axiom's `scripts/check-doc-drift.sh` — a claim the gate cannot find is a FAILURE, not a skip.
